message.content:
Let \(J = \int exp(x)*cos(x) dx\). Using integration by parts twice:

\(J = exp(x)*(sin(x)+cos(x))/2 + C\)

Therefore:

\(\int -3*exp(x)*cos(x) dx = -3*exp(x)*(sin(x)+cos(x))/2 + C\)

<answer>-3*exp(x)*(sin(x)+cos(x))/2 + C</answer>
